knowledge:
- key_parameters: start=The start date of the billing period to query (YYYY-MM-DD format) ;; end=The end date of the billing period to query (YYYY-MM-DD format) ;; project=The GCP project ID used to transmit cost data to BigQuery ;; dataset=The GCP dataset ID where billing export data is stored ;; table=The GCP table name for billing data in BigQuery ;; billing_code=The billing code associated with the request ;; key=The key type used to subset billing data (e.g., "terra-submission-id", "cromwell-workflow-id", "goog-dataproc-cluster-name")
- alternatives: Google Cloud Platform Console=Useful for high-level cost tracking but lacks the ability to easily drill down into specific Terra/AnVIL tasks, CPU/RAM usage, or workflow-level costs ;; Bioconductor's AnVIL package=Specifically the Leonardo service (Leonardo()$getRuntime()) can be used to determine the user of active clusters, whereas AnVILBilling is used for post-hoc billing analysis
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to monitor, audit, or plan costs for cloud-based analysis projects on the Terra/AnVIL platform, specifically to attribute costs to specific submissions, workflows, or notebook clusters.
- pitfalls: Billing data is generally available only 1 day after incurring charges, so real-time monitoring is not possible ;; Users must manually set up a BigQuery dataset export in GCP and ensure they have BigQuery scope on the billing project before using the package ;; The exploratory app browse_reck requires proper Google authentication.

workflows.name: reckon_and_analyze_billing_data
workflows.intent: Query GCP BigQuery billing export data for a specific time range and analyze costs associated with Terra submissions, workflows, and RAM usage.
input: GCP BigQuery billing export table (containing daily exported Google Cloud billing data for the Terra project)
workflows.stages: 1. Define billing parameters and initialize a request using setup_billing_request ;; 2. Execute the billing query and retrieve data using reckon ;; 3. Extract specific identifiers (such as submission IDs) using getValues ;; 4. Filter the billing records for a specific identifier using subsetByKeyValue ;; 5. Retrieve detailed SKU breakdowns using AnVILBilling:::getSkus ;; 6. Calculate total submission costs using getSubmissionCost ;; 7. Retrieve RAM consumption details using getSubmissionRam
workflows.code:
library(AnVILBilling)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(BiocStyle)

# setup_billing_request(start, end, project, dataset, table, billing_code)

demo_rec

v = getValues(demo_rec@reckoning, "terra-submission-id")
v

s = subsetByKeyValue(demo_rec@reckoning, "terra-submission-id", v)
s

names(s)

AnVILBilling:::getSkus(s)

data(demo_rec) # makes rec
v = getValues(demo_rec@reckoning, "terra-submission-id")[1] # for instance
getSubmissionCost(demo_rec@reckoning,v)

data(demo_rec) # makes rec
v = getValues(demo_rec@reckoning, "terra-submission-id")[1] # for instance
getSubmissionRam(demo_rec@reckoning,v)
